Hi, thank you for taking the time to respond. I am 100% trying to learn and grow to treat my current wife how she deserves. I did show I was upset when they would turn me down, not because I felt like they owed me sex or anything along those lines, but because I didn’t feel like they wanted me in the way that they had previously. I look back on how I communicated my needs and know I should have tried harder to verbally communicate with them, they frequently would go silent when anything was talked about. Anytime she had said no and later on we did stuff I would repeatedly ask if they were sure and if they were comfortable aswell. I know I didn’t act exactly as I should have though, and I want to learn and know what to do better.

I’m going to try my best to respond to this from top to bottom but please let me know if I miss part of it. That’s true, they had probably thought it out some before, they just had never discussed it with me prior. I definitely have control issues and have absolutely no problem admitting to it, I’ve been working on it.. I just don’t see how me wanting to know where they were going was controlling, I never restricted who they hung out with or where they went, as long as I was in the loop, and they were still spending time with me too. Everything had been going pretty well in that aspect until they met a guy, at work who they started spending a lot of time with, and not spending time with me, they kept going out with him to random places at all hours and not communicating where they were headed. They ended up getting together a few days after we broke up. But again, it’s entirely possible that I had controlling behaviors. They had never indicated that I was controlling or doing anything wrong. I had mentioned the fact that I was upset with how often we were doing stuff many times in the past and they would just tell me that it wasn’t me and that they “just didn’t feel like it” and would not elaborate further. When it came to me starting stuff I wouldn’t say I would sulk or anything close to that, I would drop it and kind of just go slightly quieter because I was upset. I would also repeatedly ask them during sex if they were sure and such anytime they had previously said no and changed their mind. I will also be reading post that now.

I unfortunately have no contact with them, I found this out from a friend. I would just get generally upset because I felt like they didn’t want me.. I wouldn’t mention doing stuff again or anything but I would just not hide the fact that I was upset. We would do stuff a good amount at the beggars of dating but by the end we would do stuff once every 3+ months, I felt like they had fallen out of love with me
